description: It is 5:30 in the morning. I have not moved for three hours, and both of my parents are sitting in my bedroom, turned to face my bed.

At twenty past two a scream woke me up on the other side of the house. I got as far as my bedroom door, and then I did the stupidest thing I will ever do. By the time I was back under my sheets, something was already coming up the hall, and it was not alone.
A Scroll Kaos first-person horror story, told from inside the bed. Watch until the very end.

top: - **Story rights (important):** the story was supplied as text found online, with no author, site or date. We could not confirm who wrote "I Know You're Awake" or where it first appeared, so the credit says "inspired by a story told online" and the author and publisher are marked **UNVERIFIED**. **Before you monetise, try to find the original page and ask about narration rights.** Whether permission is needed, and who can give it, is UNVERIFIED.

- No existing artwork, photograph, film still or character was used or traced. The creature is an original design built only from the story's own words (hairless, no eyes, no clothing, slouched, arms past the knees) - see story/creature.md.
- The pentagram on the wall is drawn as the story describes it (a circle with an inverted five-point star). It is a story prop, not a religious statement.
flags.age_restriction: - Age-restriction risk: two dead parents are shown seated and arranged, with bright red stains on their clothes, a dragged blood smear on the carpet and a pool on the floor. No injury, wound or act of violence is ever shown - every death happens off screen before the camera arrives. YouTube may still age-restrict it (UNVERIFIED).
bottom: - Non-graphic choices: the deaths, the screaming and anything being done to a body all happen off screen. The pictures show only the result - the stains, the arrangement, the open mouths. No open wound, no cutting on screen, no organs anywhere.
- Photosensitive safety: no strobe and no flashing. The three VHS-glitch moments are a 0.2-0.3 strength colour split on a single shot, not a flash.
- Blood: shown clearly in bright red as stains, drips, a dragged smear and a pool, because the story has blood in it (quality-law 4d, settled).
- AI voices: the narration is Kokoro text-to-speech. Three voices are used in the long video (the boy, the mother, the father) and ONE in the Reel.

- Reel shortening: the Reel keeps every main beat and the ending. It drops the bedtime scene, the father checking the locks, the stairs-and-front-door passage, the plan to run, and the "it does not know I am awake" repetition.
- Part structure: this is ONE video with four interactive parts and three choice cards inside it, matching the v0.5 reference format, not two separate uploads.
